description: Round-trip a minimal authenticated query through the configured transport. Picks `GetSavedSearchBySearchId` for magic-link consumer-shares (works for them) or `GetOneHomeUser` for agent/registered sessions. Returns the auth mode, token expiry, fetchproxy bridge role (when applicable), elapsed time, and any error detail. Run this first when a tool fails — it isolates "is auth wired up?" from "is the API itself misbehaving?".
name: onehome_healthcheck
title: Verify OneHome auth + GraphQL reachability
